encounter.title: Act I Encounter 2 — Square Candidate B (7x7 seed 66)
encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate B for Act I #2. 7x7 seed 66 (12 arrows: N3 E5 S1 W3). Cross-Lock on 7x7 board. East has 0 free arrows on start despite having 5 arrows on board. Player must lead with #1(N) to unlock #0(E) and #4(E), which in turn unlocks the final #5(N). Proven clean path without Rotate: 0 damage in 4 taps (#1 -> #0 -> #4 -> #5).
